mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact finite propagator/RWA matching, charge cancellation, distinct-mode Fock contraction controls, one nonzero on-shell delta-host capture overlap, reciprocal number/energy moments, exact Bose detailed balance, and finite Hartree-Fock support controls.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Python Fraction rational arithmetic for algebra; IEEE double for independent position-space overlap quadrature
mathematics.conventions: Natural units hbar=c=1; original charge-one Phi and charge-two X; g_NR/2 times psi-dagger-squared psi-squared. The delta host is an explicitly added 1D diagnostic potential, not a derived halo.
inputs: 81 distinct-mode Fock cases: nb,nr=0..2 and np,nq=1..3
Delta host kappa=2,m=1; incoming odd momenta3,6; outgoing even momentum7; 24000 and48000 Simpson panels over[0,12]
Bose occupations encoded by exact exponential ratios at three common fugacities and two unequal chemical-potential controls
Six Hartree-Fock support thresholds Emax/Delta in {0,1/4,49/100,1/2,3/4,1}
non_claims: No full 3D capture rate or kinetic evolution
No exact action derivation of settled/free or rho=divP
No host construction or backreaction solution
No observed particle identity, halo law, vacuum transfer, or theory completion
